name: Collapsible
description: One region that opens and closes under a trigger, for detail most people do not need at first. For a stack of related sections, use Accordion.

title.description: The trigger content. It is also the accessible name of the trigger button.

summary.description: A short line under the title that stays visible when the region is closed, e.g. a count or a status.

onExpandedChange.description: Called when the region opens or closes.

children.description: The content that opens and closes.

keyboard: Enter or Space opens or closes the region
requirements: The trigger is a button exposing aria-expanded and aria-controls
The region is labelled by the trigger
Closed content is removed from the tab order and hidden from screen readers
Opening and closing respect reduced motion
screenReader: The trigger is announced as a button, expanded or collapsed
Opening it announces it as expanded; the content follows in reading order

use_when: A single block of optional detail: advanced options, a long note, raw output
A summary with a way to see more
anti_patterns: Hiding the only way to complete a task inside a closed region
A title that does not say what is inside
